method: New chibi neutral; compact per-action pose editing; preserved AI gait structure adapted to new limb lengths; 60Hz Generic curves. Durations align to the 30fps review grid with a uniform author-time map.

motions.name: Idle_Fists
motions.intent: Upright closed-fist neutral; quiet breathing and a small, continuous weight shift.

motions.name: Walk_Fists
motions.intent: Compact in-place walk retargeted from the selected AI gait; preserve support/swing timing and closed fists.

motions.name: Run_Fists
motions.intent: Short quick running steps from the selected AI cycle; restrained arm travel and a forward gaze.

motions.name: Jump_Full
motions.intent: Small preparation, compact airborne tuck, readable apex and absorbed landing. Hips contain the preview vertical trajectory; takeoff .16s, apex .44-.52s, landing .78s.

motions.name: Dash_Forward
motions.intent: Short in-place dash pose: slight anticipation, compact forward drive, brief readable hold and one controlled recovery. No gameplay displacement.

motions.name: Punch_Right_Jab
motions.intent: Compact straight punch: small compression, fast full reach, two-frame impact hold, controlled return.

motions.name: Sword_Horizontal_Slash
motions.intent: A true waist-height XZ-plane slash. Small hand arc and body turn; the blade supplies the readable sweep.

motions.name: Sword_Aerial_Plunge
motions.intent: Already airborne at +0.45m, then a vertical accelerating sword drop, short grounded impact and compact recovery.

motions.name: Staff_Cast_Forward
motions.intent: Small draw and decisive forward staff aim; brief release hold and damped wrist return.

motions.name: Potion_Drink
motions.intent: Lift a small potion, keep its actual nozzle at the mouth during the sip, lower and return upright with closed fists.

motions.name: Item_Throw_Overhand
motions.intent: Compact shoulder-led overhand throw beside the large head; fast release, forward gaze, restrained follow-through and recovery.

motions.name: Hit_Reaction
motions.intent: Short sharp recoil and small compression, one damped settle, then upright recovery; no prolonged folded stomach pose.

motions.name: Interact_Reach
motions.intent: Small deliberate chest-height button press with a readable contact pause, soft hand withdrawal and closed-fist ready.

motions.name: Pickup_Low
motions.intent: Deep short-legged squat and downward hand reach to ground level in front of the shoes, grasp, lift and stand upright.

motions.name: Jump_Takeoff
motions.intent: Physics-ready pose phase derived from Jump_Full. Baked aerial height removed; runtime movement remains external.

motions.name: Jump_Rise_Loop
motions.intent: Physics-ready pose phase derived from Jump_Full. Baked aerial height removed; runtime movement remains external.

motions.name: Jump_Apex_Loop
motions.intent: Physics-ready pose phase derived from Jump_Full. Baked aerial height removed; runtime movement remains external.

motions.name: Jump_Fall_Loop
motions.intent: Physics-ready pose phase derived from Jump_Full. Baked aerial height removed; runtime movement remains external.

motions.name: Jump_Land
motions.intent: Physics-ready pose phase derived from Jump_Full. Baked aerial height removed; runtime movement remains external.

motions.name: Sword_Plunge_Fall_Loop
motions.intent: Physics-ready pose phase derived from Sword_Aerial_Plunge. Baked aerial height removed; runtime movement remains external.

motions.name: Sword_Plunge_Land
motions.intent: Physics-ready pose phase derived from Sword_Aerial_Plunge. Baked aerial height removed; runtime movement remains external.
